'''Pakuuni''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Pakuuni sector/Legends|Pakuuni sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
[[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] tried to bring order by establishing outpost [[NL-1]] in the [[Pakuuni system/Legends|Pakuuni system]] prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="TIE" /> The system was still under Imperial control during the time of the [[Thrawn campaign]].<ref name="TEA" /> The planet experienced a solar eclipse every seventy-six years. According to legend, this revealed a hidden tomb of the first settler, which may have had hidden treasures.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Stare into the Sun}}</ref>
